user.title: Connect to datawatch
user.description: Enter the address of your datawatch server. The next screen shows its certificate for you to check. Nothing, including a token, is sent before you approve it.

data_description.url: Starts with https://, with the port if it needs one.
data_description.token: Leave empty if your datawatch does not use a token.

reconfigure.title: Change the datawatch connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address or token. You will check the certificate again.

data_description.url: Starts with https://, with the port if it needs one.
data_description.token: Leave empty to keep the saved token for the same address. A saved token is never carried to a different address.

certificate.title: Check the certificate
certificate.description:
The server at {url} presented a certificate with this SHA-256 fingerprint:

`{fingerprint}`

Compare it with the certificate on your datawatch server itself. There, run `openssl x509 -in CERTIFICATE_FILE -noout -fingerprint -sha256`, using your certificate file.

Select Submit only if they match. From then on, only this certificate is accepted.

error.invalid_url: Enter only an https:// address, with an optional port and no path.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read datawatch at that address.
error.invalid_auth: datawatch refused access. Check the token.
error.certificate_changed: The certificate changed before you approved it. Check the address and try again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: datawatch is already set up. Only one server is supported for now.

voice_phrase_unavailable.title: The datawatch voice phrase is not working
voice_phrase_unavailable.description: datawatch could not register "open datawatch" with Home Assistant, so saying it will not start datawatch mode. A Home Assistant upgrade may have changed how this works. Check for a datawatch update. The Home Assistant log has the details.

init.title: AI assistant
init.description:
Choose an AI assistant to use with datawatch. Leave it empty to keep AI off.

While one is chosen:
- Every assistant with device control can read datawatch status, projects, open questions and documentation. Their own instructions are not changed.
- In datawatch mode, talk that is not a command goes to the chosen assistant, which keeps its control of your home.
- datawatch text is sent to your AI model. It is written by other people and programs and could try to mislead it, so check that your assistants cannot control anything sensitive.

No assistant can send an answer. That always needs you to say "confirm answer".
